evidence: tests/campaign/test_native_operator_campaign.py:142 `"--out", str(out), "--only", "record-attempted",` then :146 `post = cuts["record-attempted"]["served"]`. native_cuts.ALL_CUTS = POST_CUTS + RECOVERY_CUTS has no record-attempted (POST_CUTS: frontier-reserved, record-completing, finish-consumed, finish-durable), and main filters with `if args.only and cut.name not in args.only: continue` (native_operator_campaign.py:615). The snapshot at native_operator_campaign.py:146 is `return {"transactions": listing("transactions"), "staging": ..., "frontier": ...}`, compared at test:204 `self.assertEqual(retry["after_again"], retry["after_first"])` and test:210 `self.assertTrue(refused["unchanged"])`
fix: Point --only at a POST_LOG_CUTS cut. Make snapshot() hash the journal/ segments (or the image's committed history) instead of transactions/ and allocation-frontier.json, and fail when journal/ is missing so an unchanged result can't come from comparing None to None.
reviewer: native_cuts.py:41-61: ALL_CUTS has no record-attempted, and native_operator_campaign.py:615 filters by name, so the test's cuts["record-attempted"] at test_native_operator_campaign.py:146 raises KeyError. Its snapshot at native_operator_campaign.py:140-149 lists transactions/ and allocation-frontier.json, both absent on a log store, so after_again == after_first only really compares staging/. recover_counts["transactions"] == 2 tracks the retired per-file layout.
scenario: On hbox with FN_NATIVE_IMAGES set, the only place it isn't skipped, the driver runs just recovery-stage-unlinked, and line 146 raises KeyError. The test can never pass, and it is skipped everywhere else, so it gives no signal. Fixing the cut name is not enough: the D25 cross-entry retry rows and the production-refusal `unchanged` row compare snapshots whose transactions and frontier are None on a log store. A retry that appended a duplicate record to journal/ would still compare equal; only staging/ is really checked. The same goes for `recover_counts["transactions"] == 2`, which still tracks the per-file count.
title: Operator-campaign test filters on a cut that no longer exists (KeyError wherever it runs), and its store-unchanged snapshots compare None to None
